captions.linkedin:
Under AED 50m and in scope for UAE e-invoicing Phase 2? Your ASP deadline is 31 March 2027, and the gap assessment should come before the contract.

Under Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025, Art. 5(1)(b), in-scope businesses with revenue below AED 50m appoint an Accredited Service Provider by 31 March 2027 and implement e-invoicing by 1 July 2027 (UAE Ministry of Finance).

Myth: sign with a provider first, sort the data out later.
Fact: you can only compare quotes against needs you've mapped. Before signing, we'd check:
• Invoice and credit-note data against the PINT AE fields
• Buyer TRNs, and how your ERP outputs them
• Entities, volumes and invoice types in scope

Have an ASP quote on the table? WhatsApp us your ERP and monthly invoice volume, and we'll outline what a gap assessment would cover for your setup.
